# Templates — copy from here (do not edit this file's placeholders in place)

Two copy-paste templates: a **daily entry** and a **thread README skeleton**. Protocol: [`../CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) §6.

---

## A. Daily entry — `log/<thread>/YYYY-MM-DD_<slug>.md`

`<slug>` = 2–4 word kebab-case headline. One file per working day per thread. Append-only.

```markdown
### Target Date: YYYY-MM-DD (<short title>)
- **Hypotheses / what we're testing:** [Explicit, falsifiable statement(s). Number them H1, H2… when several. For each, state the prediction: what result would CONFIRM it and what would REFUTE it. If exploratory (no firm hypothesis yet), say so and state the question. For an organizational/setup day, say so.]
- **Setup:** [Explicitly reproducible — exact commands, config paths, seed, script sha256, GPU id(s) / tmux session, model + **dictionary identity** (which pretrained SAE/CLT, or trained checkpoint + training config), dataset, hardware. Enough to re-run without guessing.]
- **Results:** [Key quantitative metrics or outputs — the numbers only, no interpretation. For MI runs: reconstruction/L0, feature-set sizes, Semantic-Capture Score, steering Δaccuracy vs baselines, attribution-graph node/edge overlap + error-node mass.]
- **What worked / hypothesis verdict:** [Map each result back to its hypothesis: SUPPORTED / REFUTED / INCONCLUSIVE, with the evidence (quote the metric). State plainly what worked and what didn't. Did the SAE claim beat its dense-probe / prompting baseline?]
- **Observations:** [What do these results mean? Surprises, bottlenecks, or errors; MI silent-failure checks (dead features, absorption/splitting, high error-node mass, auto-interp illusion, off-target steering, base→instruct transfer).]
- **New questions / new hypotheses:** [Questions the result raises; new hypotheses to test next. These feed the thread README's "Hypotheses — open" ledger.]
- **Next Steps:** [Concrete tactical adjustments or experiments for the next session]
```

> Links from an entry to repo files use `../../<path>` (e.g. `../../docs/experiment_menu.md` or `../../results/YYYY-MM-DD_<experiment>/`). Links to sibling entries in the same thread are bare filenames.

---

## B. Thread README skeleton — `log/<thread>/README.md`

```markdown
# <thread> — <one-line purpose>

*Last updated: YYYY-MM-DD*
**Status:** not started | active | paused | done

## Hypotheses — open
- **<Hx>:** <falsifiable statement>. CONFIRM if <…>; REFUTE if <…>.

## Hypotheses — resolved
- (none yet)   <!-- move here with ✓ supported / ✗ refuted + the deciding entry -->

## What worked
- (none yet)

## What didn't
- (none yet)

## Open ideas
- (none yet)

## Entries
- (none yet)   <!-- newest first: `YYYY-MM-DD_<slug>.md` — headline -->

## Doc / results links
- (none yet)
```
